The petitioner has prayed for a writ of mandamus directing respondent No.3 to decide its objections dated 07.11.2023 in a stipulated time.

He has also prayed for referring the dispute to the Competent Authority as per provisions of Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Chairman of the petitioner-Trust has received notice dated 28.10.2023 from the Competent Authority for furnishing identity proof to ensure disbursal of the compensation amount in terms of award dated 21.10.2023.
The said notice is also issued in the name of private respondent No.4 and certain other persons.

It is also submitted in the representation that various civil litigation are pending between the parties before different courts and, therefore, until the said disputes attain finality, the compensation amount should not be disbursed to the parties.
It is urged that the application be directed to be decided within a specified time frame.
3. Shri Rajiv Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel appearing for the State-respondents has no objection to the same.

4. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of with direction to the respondent No.3-Special Land Acquisition Officer, Mirzapur to decide application of the petitioner dated 07.11.2023 by speaking order after hearing the petitioner and all other rival claimants within twelve weeks from the date of communication of the instant order alongwith photocopy of the representation.
